$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
SOURCE='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png'
test -f "$SOURCE"
test "$(sha256sum "$SOURCE" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = '429c0a45293e64de09f8da94e795c088e53afbd023337af3a59e344776412c2d'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry9-venv
/tmp/fishfry9-venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry9-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from hashlib import sha256
p=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png')
im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB')
W,H=im.size
assert (W,H)==(1536,1476)
expected=['54a7047049342d1fea774a845d06c5c97c4865b16951eac7c72c0b0ea0268673','b9cb1070f6184f9b9f61b3f35e123e0651767e290101e73221d209fe9471be88','d04714c925eac4da4d242126ba39c4ec5183524fb539134b4503d0708a87a4a7','a09536de877579dd9937b9bca15b41805b24fdf2faf54f53aeaa6027cb802bb8','f6e25ce0d75f5ec1d0c3acdc8cb6d9d3223888909d165964bbecd430f7df2df9','759cc6f2683b8275da32345c08206144dc1d89c6b34afaa1d183afd149facdc2','2d3905ac68f4731506aabae3c3c3b13d9827644a01be7acdb5c1996ed54f68c1','7f21c241a6436f95c9e495d10b21b54212f628be23dbeb88be8cca98aee32ea3','9ade1c59b48221ad3c266fe50151c8efe35655b3fddaa197cf8b61d2a2030684']
current=im.copy()
strip=im.copy()
for i in range(1,10):
  current=current.rotate(-5, resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC, expand=False, fillcolor='white')
  next_strip=Image.new('RGB',(W*(i+1),H),'white')
  next_strip.paste(strip,(0,0))
  next_strip.paste(current,(i*W,0))
  strip=next_strip
  dest=p.parent/f'pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_{5*i:02d}_step05.png'
  assert not dest.exists(), f'Destination exists: {dest}'
  strip.save(dest,'PNG',compress_level=6)
  assert sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected[i-1],f'Digest mismatch: {dest}'
  print('VALID',i,dest.name,strip.size,flush=True)
PY
git add -- terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_*_step05.png
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -c '^terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_')" -eq 9
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Add nine cumulative five-degree pizza screen rotation strips'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
  git fetch --quiet origin main
  git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
  if git push origin HEAD:main; then
    localhead=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
    remotehead=$(gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha)
    printf 'COMMITTED %s REMOTE_HEAD %s\n' "$localhead" "$remotehead"
    for i in 05 10 15 20 25 30 35 40 45; do
      path="terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_rotations_00_to_${i}_step05.png"
      gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$path" --jq '[.path,.size,.sha] | @tsv'
    done
    exit 0
  fi
done
echo 'PUBLISH_FAILED_AFTER_RETRIES' >&2
exit 1
